record.excerpt: If the D1 MACD line is above its signal line, the market is in an uptrend. … On the Hourly (H1) timeframe, take trades only in the direction of the D1 trend. … If D1 shows an uptrend, execute long entries only when the H1 MACD crosses upward. … Ignore short signals entirely. … The analysis begins in December 2018 … Annual return rises to 6.6% (from 4.6%) … maximum drawdown improves from –23.9% to –12.4% … the Sharpe ratio increases from 0.33 to 0.80.
record.notes: MACD(12,26,9) 1h entries filtered by daily MACD trend, BTC Dec 2018-Nov 2025; multi-timeframe test of compiler; base exit is H1 MACD cross down.

spec.claim_summary: Long hourly MACD crosses filtered by daily MACD uptrend improves annual return, drawdown and Sharpe.
